title: Session Scheduling Standards for Tailwise Training: Validity, Spacing, Venue
content:
# Session Scheduling Standards, Tailwise Training

Every Tailwise Training enrollment has a validity period counted in calendar days from enrollment, inside which its sessions must be used, and a minimum number of calendar days between any two of its sessions. The standards below also set the lateness after which a dog may only watch, and where private sessions may be held.

## Standards by course

| Course or pack | Validity (calendar days from enrollment) | Minimum calendar days between two sessions | Minutes late after which the dog may watch, the session counting as attended | Sessions may move to another store after the course started | Private sessions may be held at the customer's home | Travel fee per in-home session (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Training 6-Week Group | 90 | 7 | 15 | No | No | 0.00 |
| Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group | 90 | 7 | 15 | No | No | 0.00 |
| Intermediate Training 6-Week Group | 90 | 7 | 15 | No | No | 0.00 |
| Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | 90 | 7 | 15 | No | No | 0.00 |
| Private Training 4-Session Pack | 120 | 3 | 15 | Yes | Yes | 25.00 |
| Private Training 8-Session Pack | 180 | 3 | 15 | Yes | Yes | 25.00 |

## What each standard means

1. **Validity.** The number of calendar days from enrollment within which the sessions must be used. Each group course allows 90 days; the Private Training 4-Session Pack allows 120 days and the Private Training 8-Session Pack 180 days.
2. **Spacing.** Two sessions of the same enrollment are at least this many calendar days apart: 7 for each group course, 3 for each private pack.
3. **Late arrival.** A dog that arrives more than 15 minutes late may watch, and the session still counts as attended. The figure is 15 minutes on every course and pack.
4. **Store change after start.** Whether the sessions of an enrollment may move to another store once the course has started. The private packs allow it; the group courses do not.
5. **In-home sessions and travel fee.** Only the private packs may be held at the customer's home, with a travel fee of 25.00 for each in-home session. The group courses are not offered in-home, and their travel fee figure is 0.00.

## Illustrations (hypothetical dates)

- On a group course, a session attended on a Tuesday is followed at the earliest by a session on the Tuesday of the following week, 7 calendar days later.
- On a private pack, a session attended on a Monday is followed at the earliest by a session on the Thursday of that week, 3 calendar days later.
- A private pack used for three in-home sessions carries three travel fees of 25.00 each, a total of 75.00 in travel fees.
